chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, and Muhammad ibn Ismail, from Al-Fadl ibn Shazan, from Ibn Abi Umayr, and Safwan, from Muawiya ibn Ammar, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

When it is the Day of Tarwiyya, if God wills, then perform ghusl, wear your two garments (of ihram), and enter the Masjid barefoot, with tranquility and dignity upon you. Then pray two cycles of prayer near the Standing Place of Ibrahim (peace be upon him) or in the Hijr.
Then sit until the sun declines, so pray the prescribed prayer, then say at the end of your prayer as you said when you wore ihram from Al-Shajara, and wear ihram for the Hajj.
Then proceed, with tranquility and dignity upon you. So when you reach Al-Rafda, before Al-Radm, say 'Labbay'.
So when you reach Al-Radm, and overlook Al-Abtah, raise your voice with the Talbiyah until you arrive at Mina.

key_terms.التَّرْوِيَةِ: The Day of Tarwiyya, the 8th of Dhu al-Hijjah, when pilgrims proceed to Mina.
key_terms.التَّلْبِيَةِ: The recitation of 'Labbayk Allahumma Labbayk', the declaration of readiness for Hajj.
key_terms.الرَّدْم: A specific location in Mecca, further from the Kaaba than Rafda.
key_terms.الرَّفْضَاء: A specific location in Mecca, a spot of stone near the Kaaba.
key_terms.الْأَبْطَح: The flat open ground in Mecca, visible from the Rdam.
key_terms.الْحِجْر: Al-Hijr Ismail, a semi-circular wall near the Kaaba.
key_terms.الْمَسْجِدَ: The Masjid (specifically Masjid al-Haram in this context).
key_terms.مَقَامِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ: The Standing Place of Prophet Ibrahim, a sacred site in the Masjid al-Haram.

ai.seo_question: What are the ritual steps for entering Ihram on the Day of Tarwiyya according to Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi details the ritual transition from the state of Ihram for Umrah to Ihram for Hajj on the 8th of Dhu al-Hijjah, emphasizing spiritual mindfulness (sakinah) and the gradual intensification of the Talbiyah recitation as the pilgrim approaches Mina. It reflects the Shia jurisprudential emphasis on performing the Ihram prayer at the Maqam Ibrahim or in the Hijr, linking the physical act of pilgrimage to the legacy of Prophet Ibrahim. The instruction to increase vocal volume at the Radm highlights the communal and declarative nature of the Hajj rites.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr and Muhammad Bin Ismail, from Al Fazl Bin Shazaan, from Ibn Abu Umeyr and Safwan, from Muawiya Bin Ammar, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘When it will be the Day of Al-Tarwiyya (8<sup>th</sup> Zilhajj), Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Willing, so wash and wear your clothes, and enter the Masjid bare-footed, and upon you should be the tranquillity and the dignity. Then you should Pray two Cycles by the Standing Place of Ibrahim<sup>as</sup>, or by the (Black) Stone.
Then sit there until the sun declines, so Pray the Prescribed Prayers, then say at the end of your Prayer just as you said when you wore Ihraam from (Masjid) Al-Shajara, and wore Ihraam for the Hajj.
Then go, and upon you should be tranquillity and the dignity. So when you end up to Al-Rafza besides Al-Radam, so exclaim Talbiyya.
So when you end up to Al-Radam, and can see Al-Abtah, so raise your voice with the Talbiyya until you get to Mina’.
en.sarwar: 1. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr and Muhammad ibn ‘Isma‘il from al-Fadl ibn Shadhan from ibn abu ‘Umayr and Safwan from Mu‘awiyah ibn ‘Ammar who has said the following: “Abu ‘ Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that

when it is the day of al-Tarwiyah, by the will of Allah, you should take a bath and dress up in your two pieces of cloth, enter the Sacred Masjid barefoot, with calmness and dignity. Thereafter perform two Rak’at Salat (prayer) near the station of Ibrahim or in al-Hijr,

then wait until the sun declines toward the west, thereafter perform the obligatory Salat (prayer). After your Salat (prayer), you must say what you had said when assuming Ihram in Masjid of al-Shajarah. Thereafter assume Ihram for al-Hajj.
You should move on with calmness and dignity. When you arrive at al-Rafda’ (name of a place) before al-Radm (name of a place), then say Talbiyah.
When you arrive in al-Radm wherefrom you can see al-Abtah (name of a place), then raise your voice saying Talbiyah until you arrive in Mina.”
